e: Protective secretion of the mucus membranes; in the gut it lubricates the passage of food and protects the epithelial cells; in the nose and throat and lungs it can make it difficult for bacteria to penetrate the body through the epithelium; the sudden giving off of energy; the entire structure of an organism (an animal, plant, or human being).
